pages.text: If you die, your items will be stored in a $(item)corpse$() at your death point. Interacting with it will let you reclaim your items, and you can access its coordinates by pressing $(1)$(k:corpse.death_history)$().$(br2)Corpses are immune to damage, will float atop lava, and will never despawn until emptied of items.

Special behavior applies in the $(thing)End$(). Upon death in the End, your corpse will appear somewhere between the obsidian pillars on the central island. This prevents items from being lost to the void.$(br2)Lastly, if the Wither Storm is alive, it will $(thing)become distracted$() until you gather gear! There's no need to rush back to reclaim your items!
